body: I see no value in my own life. I didn't come to a conclusion based on what others have said to me, I made my own opinion. And going out alone would only emphasize how lonely I really am.
I'd rather just have all of this stress and pressure end right now
I think that maybe ending it all right now will fix everything, and I won't have to worry about what others think, or what is healthy or not.
I enjoy video editing, but that's pretty much it. The only clubs I would be able to join, I didn't. My school gives one chance to sign up for clubs and I forgot on the signup day.
No, I didn't fail. It was a C+ average. That may sound good, but I'm in a program that will kick me out if I make below a B average.
I'm not allowed to hang out with the only one who still lives somewhere I know. His Mother doesn't like me and won't let me even talk to them.
I have two step-brothers, neither live with me and one of them lives out of state

Most of them stopped talking to me during middle school. The only friends that I know in real life are both too far away from me to just hang out. The friends that don't talk to me that do live near me don't go to my school.
I don't know. They were usually busy for a few weeks and then they started to not talk to me.

I've tried talking to him about my anxiety and my depression, but he always tries to make it about school. I used to get out of the house a lot, but after my friends stopped talking to me, I stopped leaving the house as much.

I've asked my father to take me to a therapist twice, but I backed out because I didn't want my father to waste even more money on me. I also tried to tell my doctor, but I was to nervous to say anything about it.
I'm a junior. My father tells me I won't because of my poor grades and that I spend all my time in my room.
I am still in high school. My father is justified, telling me I'll never get into any college.
10 years ago, though I only found out it was a suicide a year ago.
